purpose: Route-local significance-threshold / p-value / discovery-threshold controls. Thresholds can constrain contrast classes but cannot identify candidates.

significance_threshold_rows.test_statistic_or_threshold_object: P-value, z-score, likelihood-ratio statistic, Bayes-factor-like threshold, discovery/exclusion threshold, sigma-equivalent, look-elsewhere adjusted statistic, or metadata-only threshold invoked by FAMILYC-EW-CODE.
significance_threshold_rows.null_alternative_or_look_elsewhere_test: Declare null and alternative, test statistic, nuisance handling, asymptotic approximation, trials factor, look-elsewhere region, physical boundary, selection rule, and mapping from statistic to threshold wording.
significance_threshold_rows.significance_interpretation_risk: A small p-value, large sigma, threshold pass, or local significance can be overread as posterior probability, candidate truth, global discovery, or theory identity, especially after selection, multiplicity, or model misspecification.
significance_threshold_rows.residual_gap: Significance thresholds can constrain a contrast class but do not pay coverage, calibration, benchmark, public-record, measurement, prior, or observed-sector debts.
significance_threshold_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer candidate support, discovery, exclusion, or severe-test closure from p-values, sigma thresholds, Wilks approximations, Asimov sensitivities, or threshold conventions alone.

significance_threshold_rows.significance_threshold_class: metadata/provenance wrapper; not a statistical significance claim
significance_threshold_rows.test_statistic_or_threshold_object: Lint-pass booleans, row-count thresholds, audit-zero statuses, and package-control pass/fail labels used for archive integrity only.
significance_threshold_rows.null_alternative_or_look_elsewhere_test: Archive lint checks are not scientific null-hypothesis tests and do not supply p-values or discovery thresholds for candidate physics.
significance_threshold_rows.significance_interpretation_risk: A zero-failure audit can be confused with scientific significance; it is only release-control hygiene.
significance_threshold_rows.residual_gap: Metadata thresholds preserve package integrity but do not measure physical effects or support a route.
significance_threshold_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer statistical discovery, exclusion, or route support from lint status or audit pass/fail metadata.
